jobs.description: At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide. The Role : What’s in the BoxWe are looking for a talented Category Manager to become part of our European Strategic Sourcing Team. Your role will involve contributing to the development and implementation of category strategies spanning multiple markets across Europe. As an International Category Manager, you will collaborate closely with both local and global stakeholders and help ensure we source high-quality ingredients and packaging at the best costs.This position can be based in Paris or Berlin and we have openings across several categories, including Protein; Produce, Herbs and Fruits; Grocery & Dairy; and Packaging. You will be able to tell us which categories interest you most in your application, and we will match you to the best fit.Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don't "tick all the boxes" but think you'd thrive in this role, we would like to learn more about you.What You'll Do : The Recipe- Shape the category strategy: Help build and roll out category strategies across European markets, aligned with our business objectives and supply chain needs, working hand in hand with senior team members.- Own supplier relationships and negotiations: Manage key supplier relationships across markets and lead negotiations within your scope to secure the best possible terms, working independently and constructively with internal and external stakeholders.- Drive savings: Identify and deliver cost reduction opportunities by leveraging volumes and improving processes across markets.- Build the numbers behind every decision: Develop robust cost models, run make-or-buy analyses and monitor key commodity prices, so we pay fair prices and make well-informed sourcing decisions.- Stay ahead of the market: Forecast future cost pricing using data, industry knowledge and Generative AI tools, track market trends, regulatory changes and emerging technologies, and challenge the status quo with ideas to improve our processes.- Lead projects and grow others: Drive short-term procurement projects, support long-term initiatives with cross-functional teams, solve non-routine topics autonomously (aligning regularly with your manager on priorities), and mentor junior team members, interns and working students.What You'll Bring : - Bachelor's or master's degree from a top-tier college or university, preferably in business, engineering, supply chain, finance, or science.- Minimum of 3 years of strategic procurement or production experience, preferably in the food or food-packaging industry, or alternatively as a management consultant with a focus on operations.- Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take initiative, work independently, and drive implementation.- Strong communication skills and the ability to work successfully in flexible team structures around the world.- Strong organizational and project management skills with a track record of successfully implementing cross-functional projects.- Capability to excel in flexible global team structures amid a reasonable degree of uncertainty.- Comfortable contributing to and managing projects, including developing new processes, SLAs, and KPIs.- Strong at devising creative solutions to supply issues, as well as designing, communicating, and executing action plans for effective resolution.- Convincing track record of successful negotiations with external partners.- Strong quantitative and analytical skills.- Excellent English proficiency is required, another European language is a plus.- Willingness to travel internationally up to 25% of the time.What we offer: The Toppings- The chance to have a serious impact role on one of the most exciting foodtech companies in Europe- A vibrant & international environment with a great culture & DNA- A guaranteed steep learning curve and boost for your career- A passionate, proactive, driven and dynamic French team- Offices located in the center of Paris (Paris 1er)- Competitive compensation- Delicious reductions on our HelloFresh boxes- Top tier employee experience and employees perks (Alan Blue insurance, Swile (tickets restaurant), GymLib, reductions on transport)Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Produktion, FertigungExpertenkenntnisse: Lieferantenmanagement

preferred.What we offer you- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. jobs.occupation: Expert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d) (Informationsmanager/in)
jobs.description: html Expert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d)Become part of a vital chain and contribute to our common goal of making people’s lives better. Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing medicines sourced from human plasma and human cell lines. We are a privately-owned company, where the warmth of family meets the scale of a global organisation.Octapharma Biopharmaceuticals GmbH with more than 200 employees is a subsidiary of the Octapharma group founded in 1997 and successfully expanding. Our core business is the development of recombinant proteins produced in human cell lines for therapeutic use in humans. We strive for effective treatments with an improved tolerability and convenience for our patients.Join us in shaping our vision to provide new health solutions advancing human life.We are looking for anExpert R&D Automation and Data Management (m/f/d)to join the Automation and Data Management unit within the Research and Development Department at Octapharma Biopharmaceuticals GmbH.The Automation and Data Management unit is responsible for the development, evaluation and long-term maintenance of automation- and data-driven solutions across R&D. The unit supports scientific projects by combining laboratory automation, data management, bioinformatics and scientific computing, and is involved in the work of multiple research units and virtually all projects within the department.The successful candidate will take on a challenging and versatile role with a strong focus on scientific computing, molecular modelling and high-performance computing (HPC). The position combines the application of computational methods to biological research questions with hands-on responsibility for the administration and strategic development of on-site Linux-based HPC infrastructure. Working closely with interdisciplinary research teams from all R&D units and Corporate IT, the candidate will ensure reliable and secure HPC operations while developing computational solutions to support scientific research. The role also includes contributions to internal data science and machine learning projects, with opportunities to develop expertise in new scientific and technical areas.Your main tasks and responsibilities- Development and application of molecular modelling approaches and molecular dynamics simulations to support scientific research, including protein characterization and developability studies- Administration, maintenance, optimization and strategic development of a Linux-based HPC infrastructure, including workload management and operational reliability- Development and maintenance of scripts and robust, reproducible, scalable workflows for scientific data processing, modelling and analysis, including testing and documentation- Contribution to internal data science and machine learning projects, including the evaluation and application of new computational approaches- Scientific and technical support of interdisciplinary research teams, translating research requirements into suitable computational solutions- Contribution to the integration and further development of data management, scientific computing and laboratory automation workflowsYour expertise and ideal skill set- PhD in Life Sciences with a strong focus on Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Biophysics or a related scientific discipline; postdoctoral experience is considered a plus. Candidates with an M.Sc. and extensive, highly relevant professional experience may also be considered- Practical experience in molecular modelling and molecular dynamics simulations of biological systems;
